name: Delhi (NCT)

festivals: Republic Day Parade, Independence Day at Red Fort, Qutub Festival
monuments: Red Fort (UNESCO), Qutub Minar (UNESCO), Humayun's Tomb (UNESCO), India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, Lotus Temple, Akshardham Temple

mcqs.q: Which monument in Delhi was the first garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent and inspired the architecture of the Taj Mahal?
mcqs.exp: Humayun's Tomb, built in 1569-70 by his widow Bega Begum (Haji Begum), is a designated UNESCO World Heritage Site.

mcqs.q: Through which Constitutional Amendment Act was Delhi designated as the 'National Capital Territory of Delhi' (NCT) with a Legislative Assembly in 1991?
mcqs.exp: The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991 inserted Articles 239AA and 239AB into the Indian Constitution, creating the NCT of Delhi.

subtopics.name: Geography

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is New Delhi. Delhi (NCT) covers a geographic area of 1,484 sq km across 11 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Yamuna River.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: National Capital Territory of India. Seat of the Union Government, Parliament of India, and Supreme Court. Historic city built and rebuilt over millennia (Seven Historical Cities of Delhi).

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Delhi (NCT).

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Delhi (NCT) was formally instituted on 1 February 1992 (as NCT via 69th Amendment). Official language(s): Hindi, English, Urdu, Punjabi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Kathak, Contemporary theatre.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Republic Day Parade, Independence Day at Red Fort, Qutub Festival.

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is Vinai Kumar Saxena.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Delhi (NCT) is Atishi Marlena.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Delhi High Court (est. 1966).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Nilgai | State Bird: House sparrow | State Flower: Alfalfa | State Tree: Flamboyant (Gulmohar).
